title: Battle of the big phones: How Google's new Pixel 3 XL compares to the jumbo iPhone XS Max (AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL)
text: Google’s new Pixel 3 smartphones can wirelessly charge, so it made a wireless charger to complement. But the Pixel Stand is also packed with smart features that enhance the Pixel 3 when it’s out of your hands. Recent related videos from verified sources iPhone, Galaxy and Pixel– you’d think there were only three major players when it comes to smartphones –but this is far from the truth. Oh sure, there are some great devices out.. Credit: Rumble - Published
